title: The Inner-Front Strategy: Destroy from Within
coreMove: Pressure real internal contradictions without manufacturing mistrust or healing the target through clumsy frontal attack.
sourcePressure: Some opponents cohere against external pressure and weaken only when their own tensions become unmanageable.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Plant lies or fracture ordinary groups for advantage.

hook: Do not open with a battlefield metaphor for The Inner-Front Strategy: Destroy from Within.
Do not start by saying strategy is not about violence.
counterintuition: Avoid the reusable correction frame that the move is not X but Y.
Avoid a bland paradox about strength looking like weakness.
tryThisNow: No generic timer, pause, breathe, or list-three-options prompt.
No reusable ask what matters most prompt.
examples: No generic founder in a pitch deck unless the domain requires it.
No battlefield reenactment or invented historical anecdote.
